action-failed: Could not do that. Try again.
cancel-confirm-hint: No more parts are posted. Threads already posted stay. The cancellation is logged.
cannot-join: You can join once you are a member of this community and not timed out.
edit-hint: The dates stay where they are. You can change the parts until the first one opens.
empty-hint: Pick a book from the library and set a weekly pace.
error-zone: Use a time zone name such as Europe/London.
leave-confirm-hint: Your progress is removed. You can join again later.
mod-hint: Read a library book together, a part a week, with a discussion thread behind a spoiler warning for each part. Up to {{max}} can run at once.
notify: Tell me when a part opens
paused-author: The moderator who started it is no longer a moderator here. Resume it to post as you.
paused-automod: AutoMod would have held the next part, so it was not posted.
paused-failed: Posting the next part failed several times.
paused-refused: The community rules refused the next part, so it was not posted.
paused-sanctioned: The moderator who started it cannot post here right now.
plan-failed: Could not suggest parts for this book.
plan-toc: Suggested from the book’s table of contents.
problem-label: Every part needs a short label.
problem-order: The parts must follow each other without overlapping.
problem-range: Each part needs a page range inside the book.
readers-members-only: Members of the community can see who is reading.
search-label: Find a book in the library
signed-out-hint: Members of the community can join and mark the parts they have finished.
start-day-hint: The first part opens on the first chosen weekday on or after this date.
start-hint: Pick a library book and a weekly time. Each part gets a discussion thread behind a spoiler warning when it opens.
status-cancelled: Cancelled. The threads already posted stay.
status-paused-short: Paused. Open it to see why and resume.
